lines.text: Grok in SpecWithCode: plan, build, review.
lines.spoken: Grok in Spec With Code: plan, build, review.

lines.text: In your repo, run specweave init with the generic adapter. It adds AGENTS.md and eleven SpecWeave skills.
lines.spoken: In your repo, run spec weave init with the generic adapter. It adds agents dot M D, and eleven spec weave skills.

lines.text: Grok skips project skills in folders it doesn't trust. In the repo, run grok --trust once. Signed out? Run grok login first.
lines.spoken: Grok skips project skills in folders it doesn't trust. In the repo, run grok dash dash trust, once. Signed out? Run grok login first.

lines.text: Open SpecWithCode. In the account menu, pick Settings, then Providers. Grok is off by default: click Add provider, pick Grok, existing CLI, click Next twice, then Add instance.
lines.spoken: Open Spec With Code. In the account menu, pick Settings, then Providers. Grok is off by default: click Add provider, pick Grok, existing C L I, click Next twice, then Add instance.

lines.text: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. A new chat opens. Pick Grok in the model picker, and set Full access for this demo.
lines.spoken: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. A new chat opens. Pick Grok in the model picker, and set Full access for this demo.

lines.text: Type a dollar sign, pick sw-increment, and describe the change. Grok writes spec.md: acceptance criteria and a task with its files and test.
lines.spoken: Type a dollar sign, pick S W increment, and describe the change. Grok writes spec dot M D: acceptance criteria, and a task with its files and test.

lines.text: Then send sw-do. Grok claims the task, changes the code, and runs the test. The task is marked done only when the test passes.
lines.spoken: Then send S W do. Grok claims the task, changes the code, and runs the test. The task is marked done only when the test passes.

lines.text: Click Open diff to review the code, the test, and the ledger line that records who finished the task.
lines.spoken: Click Open diff to review the code, the test, and the ledger line that records who finished the task.

lines.text: Next, sw-done verifies and closes the increment.
lines.spoken: Next, S W done verifies and closes the increment.
